subject: Full sampler state must become reachable through the real Metal factory
body: Integration reminder from sampler_state.inc review: newSamplerStateWithExactDescriptor: is an invented opt-in selector, so installed Metal callers of ordinary newSamplerStateWithDescriptor: still hit the historical narrow admission and cannot exercise full sampler support. Fine as temporary helper foundation, but do not mark application support complete with only the new selector. Required final route: ordinary Metal factory retains validated full state; each legacy binding path either proves it fits its old word or routes through v2/exact specialization (or explicitly refuses); no unsupported state can silently lose fields. Compute/frontend and render owners must call the shared per-use state helper with actual sampler-use compare/integer facts. Existing nearest/linear baseline must remain byte-compatible. Also all format/plane review findings remain pending until your STATUS/test report records exact fixes; I can review the final diff when you post readiness.
